claims: As of early April 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates are hovering around 6.1% to 6.5% for well-qualified buyers.
30-year fixed mortgage rates vary based on lender, credit score, and down payment.
Some lenders display lower rates for FHA or VA loans.
30-year fixed mortgage rates experience daily fluctuations.
Recent surveys indicate a slight rise in 30-year fixed mortgage rates.
Higher credit scores generally secure lower mortgage rates.
A 20% down payment usually avoids private mortgage insurance (PMI).
VA and FHA loans can offer lower rates compared to conventional loans.
Paying points can reduce the interest rate.
